who.value: Seller and buyer who've just agreed a deal in chat (both views)

job.value: Seller sends a payment request; buyer pays it

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The 'Payment request' tab names it, but neither chat panel shows a payment request on the first screen, just a plain negotiation thread.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: On the seller side the teal 'Leave review' is the most noticeable control, and nothing visible sends a payment request.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Buy', 'Add to cart' and 'Make offer' are clear, but the item bar truncates to 'Nike Air F...' and 'Lis...'.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Nothing beyond everyday chat and buying terms.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The seller is offered 'Leave review' and 'Archive chat' right after 'Deal 👍', before any payment has happened.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Extra options sit behind the ⋮ and report icons.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: 'Leave review' belongs after the transaction, not at the moment a deal has just been agreed.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Short chat bubbles and buttons carry it.
